segments.text:
V. 16.
And I will aſk the Father—The 21ſt Verſe ſhews the Connexion between this and the preceding Verſes. And he will give you another Comforter—The Greek Word ſignifies alſo an Advocate, Inſtructor, or Encourager. Another—For Chriſt Himſelf was one. To remain with you for ever—With you, and your Followers in Faith to the End of the World.
